root_causes.root_cause: _repair_docling_tables degenerate-row collapse (unique_vals==1 and len(cells)>3) treats multi-row table headers with identical column labels as degenerate rows and collapses them to a single cell. The logic itself is unchanged between Run 16 and Run 18 (commit 932d634 only added diagnostic logging), but the upstream Docling service was likely redeployed between runs (deploy workflow added at commits 698ac72/4da73af), producing different table markdown that now triggers the collapse condition for Schedules 1-5 headers.
root_causes.suggested_fix: Add header-row detection to _repair_docling_tables: if the row immediately follows a separator row (|---|), skip the degenerate-row collapse even when all cells are identical (multi-row headers legitimately repeat column labels). Alternatively, track whether the previous row was a separator and never collapse the row right after it.

root_causes.root_cause: content_class is never populated in the tree-path meta dict (client.py:2021-2034). The field is only set in the flat-doc routing path (client.py:1922). save_doc_meta (storage.py:506) conditionally writes content_class only when present in the meta dict. This was always the case; Run 18 scoring now checks for the field and flags its absence.
root_causes.code_path: src/pageindex_mcp/client.py::index() -> tree-path meta dict construction at line 2021-2034 (content_class never included)
root_causes.suggested_fix: Populate content_class for tree-path docs from pdf_classification (inspector_class already has the pdf_type). Add meta['content_class'] = pdf_classification.get('pdf_type') in the tree-path meta construction block, or run a lightweight post-tree classification step.

root_causes.root_cause: Docling text extraction does not adequately handle landscape-oriented pages with tabular/chart content. The 748 chars across 2 pages is byte-identical across 4+ runs, confirming this is a pre-existing architectural limitation, not a regression. The portrait companion passes because it falls through to the flat-mixed path with picture results; the landscape doc stays on the tree path.
root_causes.suggested_fix: Per RFC-034 C8: enable VLM image description (vlm_describe_images config gate) with a non-Granite model to extract chart/table data from rasterized page images. Granite-258M is user-LOCKED rejected. Alternatively, detect landscape orientation and rasterize pages before extraction.
